title: QC Analyst
description:
Quality Control Analyst



Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Working Pattern: 5 Days Onsite

The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for a Quality Control Analyst to join a leading pharmaceutical organisation. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced QC professional to join a regulated pharmaceutical environment, supporting the testing and release of materials while ensuring compliance with GMP, GDP and internal quality standards.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining laboratory quality systems, supporting audits and inspections, investigating deviations and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing of raw materials and other materials in accordance with approved specifications, procedures and agreed timelines.

  • Qualify laboratory equipment, including URS, IQ, OQ and PQ activities.

  • Maintain, calibrate and ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment.

  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems and Quality Management Systems in line with GMP and approved procedures.

  • Assist with the preparation and review of SOPs.

  • Support internal and external audits, audit schedules and regulatory inspections.

  • Raise and assist with investigations into deviations, including associated CAPAs.

  • Support technology transfer projects and QC-related activities.

  • Assist with change control implementation and management.

  • Collect and analyse data for Product Quality Reviews (PQRs) and Quality Assurance performance indicators.

  • Support the implementation and management of stability programmes.

  • Work collaboratively with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Packaging and Regulatory teams to support product release and distribution.

Requirements

  • Previous experience within a pharmaceutical Quality Control environment.

  • Strong understanding of GMP, GDP and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.

  • Knowledge of Quality Control, Quality Assurance and Quality Management Systems.

  • Experience with laboratory equipment maintenance, calibration and qualification.

  • Understanding of deviations, CAPAs, change controls and SOPs.

  • Experience supporting audits, inspections and stability programmes would be advantageous.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings effectively.

  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Excellent communication, organisational and time-management skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.


Interested? If you have pharmaceutical QC experience and are looking for your next opportunity within a regulated pharmaceutical environment, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!
